subject: Request: Ignite pilot re-entry & grace window for credits
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@igniteai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@igniteai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ignite pilot follow-up — credits expired

Hi Ben,

Quick note — we finished a short evaluation over July and had a gap in usage while we re-prioritized the roadmap. Looks like our sandbox credits expired last week and the team lost access to a few key evaluation pipelines.

We have a strong technical hit but need another 10k token burst to validate a small integration before procurement signs off. Is there a short-term path to restore access for another 7 days so we can run the final smoke tests? Happy to share a summary of what we'll run and an expected volume.

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, IgniteAI
liam.oconnor@igniteai.com
+1 415-555-0199

On Mon, Aug 17, 2026 at 16:42 Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the quick update — good to hear the integration showed promise.
> 
> -Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@igniteai.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@igniteai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite pilot follow-up — credits expired

Hi Liam — thanks for the color. Appreciate you flagging the exact need (10k tokens, ~7 days). I can jump on restoring a temporary sandbox, but for anything beyond the standard promo window I need a short internal approval.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll open a one-time credit re-entry request with Finance + Sales Ops and attach your planned usage (can you confirm the billing email and any PO needs?).
- If approved, we can re-enable a restricted sandbox for 7 days with a token cap and a quick follow-up demo to validate the integration.

Can you send the planned runbook (short bullets) and confirm the procurement contact? I’ll get this triaged today.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0122

Attachments: ignite-usage-summary-aug2026.csv (CSV, 1.2KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Ignite pilot follow-up — credits expired

Team — forwarding the request from IgniteAI. Summary: they need a 7-day reentry with a 10k token allowance to finish a final integration validation. Customer appears qualified (integration work done, procurement engaged).

Why I’m asking: grant will unblock purchase decision and likely convert to a Dedicated discussion next quarter. I’m proposing a limited temporary credit reactivation scoped like this:
- 7 calendar days
- hard cap: 10,000 tokens
- feature-limited sandbox access (no external exports)
- must complete verification call within 7 days

Attachments: proposed-reentry-terms.pdf (1 page)

Ask: Priyom — can Finance make a one-off promo allocation on the account? If yes, what approvals/constraints do you need (legal, PO, SLA)? Marissa — any concerns from a quota or audit perspective? Karthik — if we do approve, can Platform lock the token cap and sandbox scope quickly?

Happy to jump on a quick huddle.

-Ben
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Ignite pilot follow-up — credits expired

Ben — thanks for the concise packet. I reviewed their usage summary and the commercial notes in HubSpot (see link). Approve one-time reactivation under these conditions:
- Finance authorizes a promotional credit of up to 10,000 tokens tied to deal RDW-DEAL-2026-1198.
- Credit valid for 7 calendar days from the time of reactivation.
- Customer must sign an acceptance of short-term terms and confirm PO path; procurement can route final contract.
- Platform to enforce token hard cap and audit logging (Karthik to confirm).

Marissa — please flag if we need a second-level sign-off for this account due to past promo exceptions; otherwise Priyom will sign off. Karthik — if you can turn on the cap and provide a brief ops checklist I’ll queue the credit in our promo ledger and share the DocuSign link.

Priyom Das
Finance — Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
